bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 13 x 3 x 9 inches are allowed inside. Larger bags must go to coat check, which is cash only, or back to your vehicle.
allowed: Bags up to 13 x 3 x 9 inches
prohibited: Bags larger than 13 x 3 x 9 inches (coat check or vehicle)
bagPolicy.quote: We allow bags up to 13″ x 3″ x 9″ to enter the venue.

parking.summary: Parking is street parking only, and availability can vary. Milwaukee County Transit System routes 14, 15 and 22 all stop nearby, followed by a short walk.
parking.quote: Parking is currently street parking only, and availability can vary.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Falcon Bowl. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Falcon Bowl has a bar and a private, enclosed patio where you can enjoy your drinks. Smoking is allowed outside in the beer garden or in front of the building, but never inside.
concessions.quote: We also offer a private, enclosed patio where guests can enjoy their drinks.

accessibility.summary: The bar and event space have limited accessibility, and the basement bowling alley is not ADA accessible. For ADA accommodations at a show, email events@falconbowlmke.com before you go. Pets are not allowed at shows in the Hall.
accessibility.quote: If you are attending a show or event in our venue, please contact events@falconbowlmke.com for any ADA accommodations.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is allowed during events, using stamps and wristbands.
reEntry.quote: Yes! We use stamps and wristbands to allow re-entry during events.

ticketPickup.summary: There are no physical tickets, so your name and order will be on the will call list the day of the event. If the show isn't sold out, tickets are sold at the box office starting one hour before doors. Everyone must show a valid ID at entry, and the ticket buyer needs a valid photo ID to redeem tickets.
ticketPickup.quote: There are no physical tickets for events at Falcon Bowl.

gates.summary: Falcon Bowl hasn't published doors and entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.
